name: techgenius-tradein
description: Tech Genius Burlington trade-in platform — API, admin portal and embeddable widget deployed as one service.

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: cd trade-in-platform && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm run build:embed:lite
scripts.build:backend: cd trade-in-backend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm run install:scraper-browser
